description: Genset, mains, bus tie breaker, engine drive, ATS and hybrid controller: AC, DC and engine (EIC) measurements, counters, alarms, states, digital I/O, command coils and control registers
source: DEIF, AGC 150 Modbus server tables, 4189341212 UK, revision Z (software 1.39.0)

sources.title: AGC 150 Modbus server tables
sources.note: all four worksheets; groups PMS lite and PM Plant logic state left out

notes: Modbus TCP and RTU server. Coils (01, 05, 15) are commands: write 1 to run one; they read 0. Discrete inputs (02) are status flags. Holding registers (03, 06, 16) are control commands, time and the PLC write area. Input registers (04) are measurements, counters, alarms and states.
Addresses are the 'Modbus address' column of the tables (the PLC address less 1, 100001, 300001 or 400001).

The same address can mean different values on different controller types (genset, mains, BTB, engine drive, ATS, hybrid). Each entry is named for the genset controller where it applies, and its description gives the other types and names.
Not in this map: the PMS lite and PM Plant logic state groups (about 4,750 registers for multi-controller power management), the configurable Modbus area (0-499) and the alarm list (28000-28099).
Written from the manufacturer's tables; not tested on a device.
